title: 第3章 让她准备好，承受我的怒火！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 下一刻唐逸甩手就是一皮鞭。论玩鞭子，他还没虚过谁。当年在部队的时候，十八般兵器就没有他不会的。只听啪的一声，皮鞭落在王嬷嬷肥胖的身上，整条鞭子从肩膀直接打到脚后跟，皮开肉绽。顷刻间，就在王嬷嬷身上留下了一道长长的血痕！“啊！”“唐逸，你疯了，你敢打我，主母一定不会放过你的。”王嬷嬷惨叫，疼得满地打滚。“嬷嬷这叫什么话？我是在教育嬷嬷呢。”“怎么？我妹妹能承受的教育，你这么大岁数还承受不住吗？”唐逸冷笑一声，手中的鞭子噼里啪啦落在王嬷嬷的身上。每一鞭下去，王嬷嬷的身上就多出一道血痕，惨叫声也充斥着整个院子。片刻，王嬷嬷就变成一个血人了。唐音原本不敢看，双手下意识捂住眼睛，只是指缝张得大大的，正从指缝中往外瞄，蓄满眼泪的大眼睛瞪得大大的，小脸上也满是震惊。这还是她哥哥吗？哥哥什么时候有这样的本事和胆量了？“四……四少爷，别打了，别打了。”“老奴……老奴错了，老奴再也不敢了。”王桂兰满身是血，努力挣扎爬起来跪在地上，不断磕头求饶。“是大少爷和二少爷让老奴教训音音小姐的，之前大少爷和二少爷打音音小姐，还在音音小姐的伤口上撒盐。”“他们不仅笑着看音音小姐疼得满地打滚，还把音音小姐当球踢。”唐逸很清楚，王嬷嬷这时候招出唐画和唐浩兄弟，是为了转移仇恨。唐画和唐浩是唐敬的命根子，对他们极其疼爱，他要是找唐家兄弟报仇，那就是自找死路。然而唐逸听到唐音身上的旧伤是唐画和唐浩打的，而且还在她伤口上撒盐的时候，他只觉得浑身血液在这一刻都凝固了。伤口撒盐，当年他在魔鬼训练营的时候，被教官伺候过。那种疼痛，就像是全身上下有蚂蚁在啃，至今想起他还心有余悸。唐音一个五岁的孩子，那种疼痛她是怎么扛过来的？想到妹妹疼得满地打滚哇哇哭，而唐画和唐浩抱着双手在一旁大笑，还将妹妹当球踢来踢去的画面……唐逸眼睛猩红，杀意再也控制不住。“哥哥，哥哥，我没事，我好了。”女孩软糯的声音在耳边传来。唐逸低头，看到唐音双手抓着他的手正轻轻摇着：“哥哥，我已经不疼了，真的，一点都不疼。”唐逸弯腰将唐音抱起来，不疼？疼得浑身颤抖了，还不疼？“药呢？”唐逸冰冷睨向王嬷嬷，前身没发现妹妹受伤，恐怕每次遭到虐待后，他们都给妹妹敷了药。否则，妹妹活不到今日。王嬷嬷吓得一个激灵，连忙从怀中取出药瓶，递给了唐逸：“药……药在这里。”唐逸不想当着妹妹的面杀人，抬手接过药瓶，一脚将王嬷嬷踹飞出去。“滚！回去告诉颜霜玉，动我可以，但她不该动我妹妹。”“动我妹妹，他是找死！”“让她准备好，迎接我的怒火！”王桂兰如蒙大赦，当场连滚带爬出了院子。这一顿毒打，没有三个月，她不可能下得了床。“你……还是我哥哥吗？我哥哥胆子可小了。”唐音盯着唐逸，大眼睛眨了一下，眼泪从脸颊滑落。唐逸抬手揉了揉唐音的脑袋，笑道：“当然，我是你哥哥唐逸，如假包换。”“只是现在，哥哥得换个活法，不然咱们兄妹俩活不下去。”“来，哥哥先帮你清理一下伤口。”唐逸找来木盆打了一盆清水，结果却连一块毛巾都找不到，最后只能撕下麻衣的一角，帮唐音清理伤口。唐音趴在长桌上，疼得直哆嗦，眼泪哗啦，却没有喊叫一声。她已经喜欢了隐忍。看得唐逸心都碎了。帮妹妹清洗了伤口，敷了药，唐逸捡起柴堆中生锈的柴刀，扭了扭脖子看向妹妹。“走，哥带你去讨个公道！”“今日这事要是就这么算了，老子从此不叫地狱修罗，改名胆小如鼠！”唐逸不是软弱的前身。谁对他好，他十倍以待。谁对他不好，他百倍以还！……唐家，东院。颜霜玉看着满脸伤痕的儿子和儿媳，整个人也是有些懵的。“这……这都是唐逸打的？”颜霜玉难以置信，唐逸竟然还有这本事？唐浩抚着额头，道：“我们也不知道怎么了，他今天像是吃错了药一样。”颜霜玉看向林竹，林竹满脸委屈，眼底却全是怨毒：“夫君说得没错，今日的唐逸很不对劲，没有了以前半点软弱，整个人都变得果断狠戾。”他，还敢骂她丑！从他当时的厌恶的神情看得出来，他是真的在嫌弃她丑。而以前的唐逸，见到她都不敢抬头。闻言，颜霜玉脸色难看下来。陛下赐婚的圣旨，快要下来了，这时候可不能出现变故。“夫人，夫人救命，夫人救命啊……”这时，王桂兰连滚带爬地闯了进来。见到王桂兰满身是血，颜霜玉和唐浩都吓了一跳。“嬷嬷，你这是怎么了？”颜霜玉让丫鬟将王桂兰扶了起来。王桂兰却连站都站不稳，指着西院哆嗦道：“是唐逸，夫人，是唐逸打的老奴。”“唐逸疯了，他敢打老奴，还要老奴告诉您，让您准备好，接受他的怒火！”听完王桂兰的话，颜霜玉脸色冰冷至极。“接受他的怒火？可笑！凭他一个死了母亲的废物，能翻出什么浪花来，敢翻出什么风浪来！”她指着唐浩和王桂兰道：“现在老爷应该回来了，你们去大门等老爷回来，他回来立即和他告状。”话落，她看向林竹，道：“你现在回去，就说受到惊吓不见任何人。”林竹身上虽然有唐逸打的伤，可唐浩帮她画的妆还是太明显了，指控唐逸可能会发生意外。“至于我，孔家小姐孔诗岚刚刚递了拜帖，我亲自出去接她。”“这场好戏，总得有观众不是。”颜霜玉冷笑一声，带着丫鬟出了门。唐浩，林竹以及王桂林明确分工后，也都行动起来。这一次，一定要让唐逸万劫不复！
content_en: The next moment Tang Yi waved his hand with a whip.When it comes to playing with whips, he has never failed anyone.When he was in the army, he couldn't master any of the eighteen weapons.There was just a snap sound, and the whip fell on Grandma Wang's fat body. The entire whip hit her from the shoulder to the heel, and the skin was torn.In an instant, a long blood mark was left on Grandma Wang’s body!"Ah!" "Tang Yi, you are crazy. If you dare to hit me, Mistress will never let you go." Grandma Wang screamed and rolled on the ground in pain."What are you talking about, mama? I'm educating mama." "What? The education that my sister can bear, can't you bear it at such an old age?" Tang Yi sneered, and the whip in his hand fell on mama Wang with a crackle.With each stroke of the whip, there was a blood mark on Grandma Wang's body, and screams filled the whole yard.In a moment, Grandma Wang turned into a bloody person.Tang Yin originally didn't dare to look, so she subconsciously covered her eyes with her hands, but her fingers were wide open, and she was looking out from between her fingers. Her big eyes full of tears were wide open, and her little face was full of shock.Is this still her brother?When did my brother have such ability and courage?"Four...Fourth Young Master, stop fighting, stop fighting." "Old slave...Old slave is wrong, I don't dare to do it anymore." Wang Guilan, covered in blood, struggled to get up and knelt on the ground, kowtowing and begging for mercy."It was the eldest young master and the second young master who asked the old slave to teach Miss Yinyin a lesson. The eldest young master and the second young master beat Miss Yinyin before and rubbed salt on Miss Yinyin's wounds." "They not only laughed and watched Miss Yinyin rolling on the ground in pain, but also kicked Miss Yinyin like a ball." Tang Yi knew very well that Grandma Wang recruited brothers Tang Hua and Tang Hao at this time to divert hatred.Tang Hua and Tang Hao were Tang Jing's lifeblood, and he loved them extremely. If he sought revenge against the Tang brothers, he would be asking for death.However, when Tang Yi heard that Tang Hua and Tang Hao had inflicted the old wounds on Tang Yin's body, and that they were rubbing salt on her wounds, he felt that all the blood in his body had solidified at this moment.To add salt to the wound, he was served by an instructor when he was in the devil training camp.The pain was like ants gnawing all over his body, and I still feel frightened when I think of it.Tang Yin was a five-year-old child. How did she endure that kind of pain?Thinking of the scene where his sister was rolling on the floor and crying in pain, while Tang Hua and Tang Hao were holding their hands and laughing, kicking their sister around like a ball... Tang Yi's eyes were scarlet, and he could no longer control his murderous intent."Brother, brother, I'm fine, I'm fine." The girl's soft voice came to her ears.Tang Yi lowered his head and saw Tang Yin holding his hand and shaking it gently: "Brother, I don't feel any pain anymore. Really, it doesn't hurt at all." Tang Yi bent down and picked up Tang Yin. Doesn't it hurt?It hurts so much that I'm shaking all over. Doesn't it still hurt?"Where's the medicine?" Tang Yi looked at Grandma Wang coldly. The predecessors didn't notice that their sister was injured. I'm afraid they had applied medicine to her every time she was abused.Otherwise, my sister would not survive today.Grandma Wang was so frightened that she quickly took out the medicine bottle from her arms and handed it to Tang Yi: "The medicine...the medicine is here." Tang Yi didn't want to kill anyone in front of his sister, so he raised his hand to take the medicine bottle and kicked Grandma Wang out."Go away! Go back and tell Yan Shuangyu that she can touch me, but she shouldn't touch my sister." "To touch my sister, he is seeking death!" "Let her prepare for my anger!" Wang Guilan rolled out of the yard on the spot as if she had been granted amnesty.After such a severe beating, it would be impossible for her to get out of bed within three months."Are you...still my brother? My brother is so timid." Tang Yin stared at Tang Yi, blinked his big eyes, and tears fell from his cheeks.Tang Yi raised his hand and rubbed Tang Yin's head, and said with a smile: "Of course, I am your brother Tang Yi, I am correct." "It's just that now, brother has to change his way of living, otherwise we brother and sister will not survive." "Come, brother, help you clean the wound first." Tang Yi found a wooden basin and filled it with water, but he couldn't even find a towel. In the end, he could only tear off a corner of his linen clothes and help Tang Yin clean the wound.Tang Yin lay on the long table, shivering in pain and bursting into tears, but did not cry out.She already likes forbearance.Tang Yi's heart was broken when he saw it.After cleaning his sister's wound and applying medicine, Tang Yi picked up the rusty hatchet from the firewood pile, twisted his neck and looked at his sister."Let's go, brother, I will take you to seek justice!" "If this is the case today, I will no longer be called Hell Shura, but will be renamed as cowardly as a mouse!" Tang Yi was not a weak predecessor.Whoever treats him well will be treated tenfold.Whoever treats him badly, he will repay him a hundredfold!...Tang Family, East Courtyard.Yan Shuangyu looked a little confused when she looked at her son and daughter-in-law, whose faces were covered with scars."This... this was all caused by Tang Yi?" Yan Shuangyu couldn't believe it, Tang Yi actually had such ability?Tang Hao stroked his forehead and said, "We don't know what happened. He seems to have taken the wrong medicine today." Yan Shuangyu looked at Lin Zhu. Lin Zhu's face was full of grievance, but his eyes were full of resentment: "My husband is right. There is something wrong with Tang Yi today. Without any weakness before, he has become decisive and cruel." He dared to call her ugly!It could be seen from his disgusted expression at that time that he really disliked her for being ugly.In the past, Tang Yi didn't dare to raise his head when he saw her.Hearing this, Yan Shuangyu's face turned ugly.Your Majesty's imperial edict granting marriage is about to come down, and there can be no changes at this time."Madam, madam, help me, madam, please help me..." At this time, Wang Guilan rushed in crawling.Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hao were shocked when they saw Wang Guilan covered in blood."Mommy, what's wrong with you?" Yan Shuangyu asked the maid to help Wang Guilan up.However, Wang Guilan couldn't even stand still. She pointed to the west courtyard and trembled: "It's Tang Yi, madam, it's the old slave that Tang Yi beat." "Tang Yi is crazy. He dares to beat the old slave, and he wants the old slave to tell you to prepare yourself to accept his anger!" After hearing Wang Guilan's words, Yan Shuangyu's face turned extremely cold."Accept his anger? Ridiculous! How can he, a loser with a dead mother, stir up trouble and dare to stir up trouble!" She pointed at Tang Hao and Wang Guilan and said: "The master should be back now. You go to the gate and wait for him to come back. When he comes backFile a complaint with him immediately." After saying that, she looked at Lin Zhu and said, "If you go back now, just say you're scared and you won't see anyone." Although Lin Zhu had injuries from Tang Yi's beating, the makeup Tang Hao painted on her was still too obvious, and accusing Tang Yi might cause an accident."As for me, Miss Kong Shilan of the Kong family has just handed over a greeting card, and I will go out to pick her up in person.
title_en: Chapter 3 Let her prepare to bear my wrath!
